Claude Code, Codex, Gemini … mit ihren H: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini … with their home folders – no need to sign in again. If you keep using the same subscription in nrzCode, the provider may sign one of the two out later; just sign in again there.
Wähle „Login with Google“ (Eingabetaste): Choose “Login with Google” (Enter), open the link shown, sign in with your Google account and paste the code Google shows afterwards here into the terminal. Then leave with “/quit”.
luCode installiert die Agent-CLIs in sei: luCode installs the agent CLIs into its data folder (tools/npm) and looks for programs there first, then in the PATH. If Node.js is missing, luCode downloads it to tools/node first. The Docker CLI goes to tools/bin – with it agents can build images and push them to the git platform's registry.

Jeder Benutzer hat eigene Projekte, Thre: Every user has their own projects, threads, agent accounts and their own connections to git platforms.
Ab Werk bietet luCode GitHub an. Eingesc: Out of the box luCode offers GitHub. Switched on, Settings → Git platforms also shows the self-hosted platforms to connect – for all users. Platforms that are already connected are always there.

GitHub geht zusätzlich: ein Personal Acc: GitHub works in addition: paste a personal access token (github.com → Settings → Developer settings). A classic token needs the scope “repo” (plus “read:org” for organisations), a fine-grained one Contents, Pull requests and Administration with read and write. luCode clones, pushes and opens pull requests; agents get GitHub as an MCP server (github) and can use the gh CLI.
Öffne github.com → Settings → Developer: Open github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens (the button “Create token on GitHub” above takes you there).
Erstelle ein Token: klassisch mit dem Re: Create a token: classic with the scope “repo” (plus “read:org” for organisations) – or fine-grained with Contents, Pull requests and Administration (read and write). Copy it – it is shown only once.
Füge das Token oben ein und klicke auf „: Paste the token above and click “Connect”. luCode checks it right away.
Fertig: Unter „Projekt hinzufügen“ ersch: Done: your repositories appear under “Add project”. luCode clones, pushes and opens pull requests; agents get GitHub as an MCP server (github) and can use the gh CLI.
luGit: Adresse (z. B. http://umbrel.loca: luGit: enter the address (e.g. http://umbrel.local:8430) and an access token (lgt_…) with the scopes “user” and “repo”. From luGit 1.1.0 on agents get luGit as an MCP server (lugit); with older versions luCode clones, pushes and opens pull requests, and agents work with git there.
luCode klont, pusht und legt Pull Reques: luCode clones, pushes and opens pull requests with your access token. From luGit 1.1.0 on agents get luGit as an MCP server.
